CustomField.description: When ticked, a failed call of this service leaves an API issue that a person can review, run again or dismiss. Outbound: a call your org sent that failed or was refused. Inbound: a request your org received that failed in the service's code, was refused by its checks, or whose changes could not be saved. The inbound issue links to its call, which keeps the request. A request refused because it reused an Idempotency-Key with another body writes no issue, and neither does a failed run of an issue's request again.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Tick to record each failed call of this service as an API issue. Outbound: a call your org sent that failed. Inbound: a request your org received that failed or was refused; the issue links to the call, which keeps the request. Resolve Issues and Retry Issues act on these issues.
CustomField.label: Log Issues
